---
title: "Workshops"
---

We organise workshops on various topics, ranging from data visualisation with `ggplot2` to using Palaeoverse packages, debugging R code, or creating R packages. These workshops are open to people with any skill level: whether you are a novice or an advanced R programmer, there will be something that matches your experience.

This content is also available as self-contained modules listed on the [Modules page](../modules/), and past workshop teaching materials are available [here](https://workshop.palaeoverse.org/){target="_blank"}. 

We have trained more than 150 researchers, and we will organise several workshops as of 2027. You can find the complete list on our [Events page](../../events). Reach out to [info@palaeoverse.org](mailto:info@palaeoverse.org) if you have any questions or if you are interested in helping organise more workshops.
